resolution.note: krn lane start refuses at KRN_OPEN_RED_MAX (default 3) red or missing Check PRs; test/rules/open-red-limit.test.ts asserts refusal at 3, pass at 2

title: Refuse new lanes while too many open PRs have a red or missing Check
body:
Source: t-tpkc9xz trial (radar 6), .krn/runs/research/rss-trials/f-g-h-radar.md
Outcome: krn lane start refuses when open PRs with red or missing Check reach KRN_OPEN_RED_MAX (default 3).
Proof: node --test test/rules/open-red-limit.test.ts beside lane-limit.test.ts with a stubbed PR list asserting refusal at 3.
